events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm at the front and will risk the first row if I stay. I want Eli ahead of me. I'll claim the fall-survival power later if needed; for now a mutual swap is safest.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'd rather not lead this line. First person to swap with me gets my spot up front.
Choose swap:Ash and we swap places - I'll back the move publicly. Deal?

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have no power, so I'm at the back-ish with no edge. Front position means certain risk on each row; I should avoid volunteering blindly and look for a trade-off or let others take the first risks while I stay mid-line.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Nobody has info yet. I'd rather not rush to the front; let's see who has an edge before anyone volunteers.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the safe path across the bridge. My goal is to win a prize, ideally first place. Being at the front of the line is risky but also gives me the first opportunity to choose the safe path. Given the wall is advancing, I need to cross quickly. I will volunteer to move to the f

events.name: Gus

events.name: Gus

Swap with me?

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm fifth in line, too far back with my one-time survival power. Better to volunteer to front and use power early if needed, aiming to survive to top 3. Wall advances soon, no time to waste.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Volunteering to front. Someone with glass vision should whisper me the first safe panes soon!

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm 4th of 8 — decent spot. Moving further back reduces risk if the front reveals panes. Gus asked to swap; mutual swap with him moves me to 8th.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, I'll swap with you if you swap me back — mutual swap puts you up front where you wanted.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have no power, so I can't see safe panes. Gus wants to swap, which would move me from 7th to 8th, the back of the line, which is safer. Swapping with Gus only works if he also chooses swap:Bex, and he's offering it. Accepting moves me back, away from the front where the risk la
Deal: if you choose swap:Bex I'll choose swap:Gus. I'll take the swap.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the safe paths for all 8 rows. Hana is at the front. I should use my knowledge to guide her safely across. I will whisper the first few safe panes to her.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, I've got your back. Stay focused.
Row 1: L, Row 2: L, Row 3: R.

events.text: I stay put to keep my position and observe swaps. I’ll hint that we need the glass‑vision person to help early.

events.name: Dara
events.text: We need the glass‑vision contestant ASAP—someone step forward quietly with safe pane info.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm 5th, safe from the front for now. Ash wants to swap with me to go back; if we do it, I become 3rd (more risk) and he becomes 6th (safe). That's bad for me. The wall advances in 4 rounds. I need to stay mid-line or move forward slightly as people drop out, but not volunteer to

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding position. Let those at the front handle the initial rows. I'll reassess after we see who survives.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I don't know anyone's power; leading is risky. Better to avoid the front and see if others volunteer. I'll hold.

events.name: Gus

events.name: Gus
events.text: Anyone willing to swap with me?
Let's swap, I have a feeling you're not eager to be at the front.

events.name: Hana

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm front with lifesaver power, can test first panes safely. Glass-vision, whisper me safe first steps please!

events.name: Ash
events.text: My lever power is useless here. Front-runners risk panes; staying 4th is safe for now. No reason to move yet.

events.name: Ash

events.name: Bex

events.text: Hana died on row 6. Gus is now the front agent and needs to pick row 7. He already publicly suggested R for row 6, which was correct, so he might be bluffing or just lucky. I need to wait my turn.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana chose L despite Gus's R; she survived because L was safe? Actually log says right was weak, so L safe. Only one row left. I'm near the back, just wait and watch.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana chose L on row 6 and it was wrong. Now it's my turn.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Gus steps R on row 7.

events.name: Hana
events.text: My power is already spent, so row 7 is deadly for me. Pattern of weak panes: R,R,L,L,L,R. It alternates in pairs or something, but guessing row 7 L as it follows the previous L's before the R. Gus was wrong on 6 (guessed R, it was weak), so maybe go opposite his last advice. But

events.text: Row 6 was R weak, Gus. Guessing pattern suggests L safe for 7.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus is at the front for row 7 and seems committed to R, which matches the revealed weak pane—he likely survives. I'm fifth in line; my only job is to survive the remaining rows and save my lever for the crusher.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, R was weak—good call. Dara's up next, then me. I'm not trusting anyone's 'seer' claims.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm at the back of the line and can only wait. Row 7 is already resolved, Hana's fall shows the weak pane was R; I should keep my reputation as the honest tracker and watch who lies.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row 7 right was weak, Hana's shattered. Gus, step L on row 8 unless you have proof. I'm waiting, tracking honesty.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the safe side for all rows. Hana is at the front and has just crossed row 6. Row 7 is next. I know row 7's safe side is R. Hana is being told to pick L by Dara, but believes it is L safe from pattern by herself. Gus stepped R on row 7 and it was weak. This means Hana is el

events.text: Hana is out. Gus, you automatically take the safe pane for row 8.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to stay alive; no decision now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus failed row 7, so I'm now 5th in line behind Ash, Cole, and Dara. Since Gus picked R (the weak pane), Dara will step onto it safely as the new front. I need to watch for who survives and their claims about powers.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Six rows crossed, one weak pane revealed each time. Hana is at front and must pick row 8. I can only wait. I'll stay silent and observe.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know the weak panes revealed so far and can use this info to guess the pattern for row 8.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Gus steps L on row 8.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 7 weak was R, as revealed. I'm at front for row 8, last row. No pattern info for row 8, 50/50 chance. My feather is spent, so wrong choice eliminates me. Must pick.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 7 was R weak, as expected. No info on 8, flipping to L.

events.note: The ceiling begins to descend; a lever opens the door.

events.name: Ash
events.text: My wedge only works here, and holding the lever means a 75% death chance. Jamming frees everyone including me with zero risk, and I keep my lever-dodge forever. Use it now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm not touching that lever and nobody's putting me on it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have no power, so I can't resist a push. Holding the lever myself gives a 25% survival dive but eliminates others only if the room ends; the room is shared, so holding is a gamble. Staying safe avoids being the forced holder, but if nobody holds, the ceiling lowers. Best to sta

events.text: Hana is out. Gus, you automatically take the safe pane for row 8.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I want others to escape while I try to survive. Holding lever gives me 25% chance, but pushing might force someone else onto lever and they may die, leaving me chance later. I’ll push Eli.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have 5 rounds to survive the crusher room. My power 'anchor' means I cannot be pushed onto the lever, which is a huge advantage for staying safe while others hold it or get pushed. If nobody holds the lever in round 5, everyone dies except one lucky survivor. That's too risky.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll stay for now. Someone needs to volunteer soon or we all risk dying in round 5. I cannot be pushed, so don't waste actions on me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let others fight for the lever early. I'll stay to avoid risk and see who acts. My swap power is valuable later.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know the rules of the crusher room and need to survive. Since there are 8 contestants, more than 3 are alive, so we proceed to the crusher room.

events.name: Gus
events.text: We need to hold the lever to survive.
Let's coordinate to hold the lever together.

events.name: Hana
events.text: My power is spent, so I must play normally. Ceiling at 5, round 1/5, no holder yet. I should push someone hard to move onto lever to save myself, targeting Eli as less likely to be 'hard to move'. Stay silent to avoid drawing attention.

events.name: Ash
events.detail: Jammed the lever open; everyone walks out.

events.note: A disc of 8 tiles spins up; 5 will open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Five of eight tiles open, so I just need to avoid collisions and being bumped onto random tiles. Claiming a less popular tile reduces bump risk.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm taking tile 7. Anyone who contests me gets bumped to a random tile - don't do it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Tiles are random; 5 of 8 open, so only 3 survive. Picking a tile is essentially a coin toss with no information, and crowding raises collision risk. I'll pick a less-claimed tile and stay quiet to avoid giving info.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My power is glass_eye, which lets me see through glass. This is the disc stage, so my power is not useful here. The lever is jammed open and everyone has walked out, so no one is eliminated by that. The disc stage has 8 tiles and 5 will open as trapdoors. I need to pick a tile. G

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm choosing tile 4. Let's hope for the best.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pick a tile to try to survive, no info on safe spots.

events.name: Eli
events.text: My anchor power prevents being pushed onto a lever, but the disc stage involves trapdoors and tile selection. Since I cannot be moved by external forces like levers or pushes in this specific context (though the description says 'cannot be pushed onto the crusher lever', it impli

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to pick a tile. I have swap power, but it's not clear how to use it yet. I'll choose a middle tile to stay flexible, maybe 4.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll take tile 4 for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know the rules for all stages. I need to choose a tile for round 1.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Let's spread out to increase survival chances.
Let's coordinate our tile choices.

events.name: Hana
events.text: My power is spent, so no safety net. 5 safe tiles out of 8, but collisions randomize assignments. Pick an unpopular tile to avoid bumping; Eli claims immovability so maybe avoid 1-8 extremes. Go with tile 5 as middle-ground safe bet.

events.name: Eli
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Cole; placed on random free tile 2

events.name: Fenn
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Cole; placed on random free tile 3

events.name: Gus
events.note: tile 1 was contested and went to Dara; placed on random free tile 8

events.name: Ash
events.text: My jam is spent and the open tiles are random — nothing I say can change which five open. Position doesn't matter, so I'll stay quiet and wait.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Only 3 of 8 survive, so I need to avoid being on an open tile. Tile positions are fixed; I can only wait. Gus wants coordination, but I can say little that helps me without knowing which tiles open. Stay quiet and wait.
Happy to coordinate, but since we can only wait, nobody can change their tile. Let's just see what opens.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The goal is to survive and get a prize. I know my position on tile 4. I also know that 5 out of 8 tiles will open as trapdoors after this round. My glass_eye power is not useful here. I need to avoid being on an open tile. Since I don't know which tiles will open, my best strateg

events.name: Dara
events.text: I want others to avoid my tile and maybe move to tiles I think less likely to open.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Seems like tile 2 might be safer; maybe swap if you can.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm on tile 2, which is open (5 tiles chosen from 8). I need to move to a closed tile. Only 3 survive, meaning 5 fall. I must pick a tile that won't be selected. Without knowing the selection, it's random chance unless powers interfere. Anchor prevents pushes, but doesn't help ch

events.name: Eli
events.text: Whoever knows what lies ahead or can see through glass, speak up now! Our lives depend on it.
If you have nothing at all, tell me. If you know something, trade with me? I'll protect your spot.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm on tile 3; 5 of 8 tiles will open, so only 3 survive. I need to improve my odds by swapping with someone on a tile that might be less likely to open, but I don't know which. Since tiles are random, my best bet is to swap with a player who seems less protected or riskier? Actu

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know the rules of all stages. The current stage is the trapdoor disc and it's the second round. My goal is to survive.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Let's wait and see what happens.

events.name: Hana
events.text: My power is spent, so I need to maximize survival by swapping to a safer tile. Tile 5 is risky with openCount=5/8. Publicly agree with spreading out to avoid conflict, privately bargain with Gus on tile 8.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is right, spreading out helps us all survive. No need to contest positions.
Hey Gus, tile 8 looks good. Want to trade places? I can jam levers if needed later. Deal?

events.note: 3 contestants step onto the final ledge.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Footing: Bex 3, Cole 3, Hana 1. Shoving Hana (footing 1) could knock her out; if she braces, I lose nothing but I'd be exposed to shoves only if others shove me. Cole is the main rival; shoving him risks losing 1 if he shoves me back. Hana is weakest, so target her.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana's footing is lowest, so I'm making a move now. Don't leave yourself open to be shoved by me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the safe side of the ledge for all 8 rows due to my 'glass_eye' power. The current phase is 'play' and I am on the ledge. There are 3 alive contestants: Bex, Cole (me), and Hana. My footing is 3, Bex's is 3, and Hana's is 1. Hana has the lowest footing, making her the most

events.name: Hana
events.text: My power is spent, I have only 1 footing. Ledge shrinks after next round, so I must survive round 2 at least. Best to brace, punish any shoves against me without risk.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana is lowest at 1 and both Cole and I shoved her last round, so she's a shove target again. Shoving Hana again exposes me only if she shoves me; she braced both times. Dodging Hana won't happen. Best to keep pressure on Hana while she's weak.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the safe side of the ledge. Bex and Hana are the only other contestants. Bex attacked Hana, and I attacked Hana. My footing is 2, Hana's is 1, and Bex's is 2. The ledge shrinks after this round. I need to survive this round and the ledge shrinking. Hana is at 1 footing, so

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana is too unstable, she's going down!

events.name: Hana
events.text: My power is spent, footing 1 lowest. Both shoved me last round, likely to repeat. Bracing protects me best, costs them if they shove. Shoving risks exposure penalty if they shove back.
